title: Pneumatic tubing.
officialText:
Combustible pneumatic tubing exposed within a plenum shall have a peak optical density not
greater than 0.50, an average optical density not greater than 0.15, and a flame spread of not greater than 5 feet (1524 mm)
when tested in accordance with UL 1820. Combustible pneumatic tubing shall be listed and labeled.
